description: AquaTwin datasets backing the missed-rain / electricity-slot safety feature.

field_day_irrigation_dataset.csv.origin: downloaded.csv supplied by user (synthetic water-balance simulator AquaTwinSyntheticWaterBalance-1.0)

train.csv / val.csv / test.csv.origin: generated by dataset/generate_data.py (seed 42) from dataset/aquatwin_twin.py physics
train.csv / val.csv / test.csv.use: calibration / backtesting of the daily water-balance engine

fields.csv.rows: 100 rows, one per synthetic field: soil texture, texture fractions, farmer profile, start date

datasets.aquatwin_twin.py: FAO-56 style daily root-zone water balance used by the generator and what-if simulation

safety_note: All data are SYNTHETIC. Parameter calibration checks against these tables are grounded in this corpus only; they are not real-farm agronomic advice.
